## Summary

Describe the smallest user-visible or maintenance change.

## Owning repository

- [ ] `fundgraph` project documentation/governance
- [ ] `fundgraph-core` library/domain behavior
- [ ] `fundgraph-cli` executable behavior

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Documentation/state/changelog updated where applicable

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No credentials or private source included
- [ ] No hidden network calls, payment execution, or identity inference added
- [ ] Contradictory evidence remains explicit
- [ ] Compatibility impact is documented
